banners.title: Welcome hoarding
banners.place: Varanasi airport arrival hall, facing the exit from the baggage belts

banners.title: “Kural of the hour” screen
banners.place: Lounge and gate screens: one couplet every 15 minutes, steady text, no flashing

banners.title: One couplet, many languages
banners.size: Wall panels, 4 × 6 ft each (2 : 3), a series of 10
banners.place: Along the aerobridge: passengers walk past the same couplet in the languages of India

banners.title: Platform clock strip
banners.place: Fixed beside or below the platform clock

banners.title: Coach theme panel
banners.place: Above the doors inside the coaches of the trains carrying delegates to Varanasi: one chapter's theme per coach

banners.title: Stair-riser couplet
banners.size: Vinyl on 7 stair risers, about 6 ft × 6 in each
banners.place: Footbridge steps: the seven words of the couplet, read from the bottom step up

banners.title: Safety point panel
banners.place: Beside fire extinguishers and emergency exits, never over the safety signs themselves

banners.title: KTS 5.0 countdown
banners.where: Stations and airports in Tamil Nadu and Varanasi
banners.place: Chennai, Madurai, Coimbatore, Rameswaram, Kanyakumari and Varanasi
